verdict.rationale: Vast.ai offers a full CLI and REST API for scriptable, non-interactive control of the entire instance lifecycle (search, create, destroy), confirmed by both docs and hands-on runtime probes running keylessly. Scoped API keys are explicitly recommended for CI/CD and shared tooling, and the CLI was verified to run headlessly via uvx with no login. Missing for 10: no explicit CI pipeline example (e.g., GitHub Actions workflow) or third-party case study of running it in an automated CI pipeline.
